note: After the original description of Emerson (1925) (in English), the species being new in that work; the original describes only the alate (figures a—c show the head and pronotum in dorsal view, the head in lateral view, and the wing), not the soldier or the worker. Measurements: body length with wings 13.00—14.00 mm, without wings 8.00—8.50 mm, head length 2.00—2.12 mm, head width 1.71—1.76 mm, antennal length 2.73 mm, eye diameter 0.67 mm, pronotum length 0.80 mm, width 1.90 mm, hind tibia 1.45 mm, fore wing 11.50 mm long, 3.07 mm wide. Type locality Kartabo, British Guiana, known only from the type locality.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, with numerous setae; head shape oval. Antennae 18-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 equal in length. Compound eyes rather large, the distance from the lower margin of the head about one-third of their diameter (0.29 mm); anterior margin of the eye straight. Ocelli medium-sized, touching the compound eyes. Pronotum yellowish brown, with numerous setae, wider than the head; sides rounded, posterior margin nearly straight. Arolia present between the claws. Wings transparent, the veins near the anterior margin brown; subcosta, radius and media distinct; cubitus indistinct except near the base. Radius with 6—8 branches; cross-veins between radius and media; cubitus with 11—14 branches. Abdomen yellowish brown, tergites with numerous setae.
